'''Adras''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;held [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], a team of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] was tasked with meeting another group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents in order to lead a group of combat [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to join the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|main Rebel Fleet]].

Before the two teams could meet outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nezan]] on Adras, the Sullustans were arrested by Imperial authorities and [[Prisoner/Legends|held]] at a [[Unidentified detention center|detention center]] near Nezan. The other Rebel group eventually discovered their allies' fate and helped them escape the [[Prison/Legends|detention facility]] and leave Adras, allowing them and the combat vessel group to rendezvous with the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]].

==Description==
Adras was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] with dark [[Standard day/Legends|night]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]].<ref name="GG52" /> It was located in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector's]] [[Adras system/Legends|Adras system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">According to {{WEGCite|story=Remnants of the Empire (adventure)|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)}}, the events on Adras take place shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Adras was under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a team of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] was tasked with leading a group of combat [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to rendezvous with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|main Rebel Fleet]] near<ref name="GG52" /> the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] planet<ref name="EAOC Sullust">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]</ref> [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="GG52" />

===Rendezvous near Nezan===
{{RPGseed}}
To achieve their objective, the Sullustans were to meet another group of Rebel agents on Adras, outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nezan]]. The group carried a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]] containing the coordinates of the Rebel [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] and were to pick up the Sullustans, who possessed a [[Decrypt unit|decrypter]] that allowed them to access the information on the datadisk.<ref name="GG52" />

However, before the meeting could take place, the Sullustans were detained by Imperial officials on charges of expired identification documents and [[Prisoner/Legends|held]] at a [[Unidentified detention center|detention center]] on Nezan's outskirts. When the Sullustans failed to show up at the meeting site, the group of Rebel agents entered Nezan, where, through several sessions of information trading and risky encounters with Imperial personnel, they were able to determine the fate of the missing Intelligence officers.<ref name="GG52" />

===Escape from Adras===
[[File:MF-Through-Fleet.png|thumb|right|300px|Rebel agents on Adras helped bring reinforcements to the Alliance Fleet (pictured) prior to the Battle of Endor.]]
After making their way into the [[Prison/Legends|detention center]], the group of Rebel agents finally met the Sullustan officers, and together the two teams escaped the facility. Upon learning of the detainees' escape, the Imperial authorities launched a city-wide alert, forcing the Rebels to sneak onto their starship under the cover of darkness.<ref name="GG52" />

The Rebel ship then took off and evaded a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of Imperial [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] [[Interceptor/Legends|starfighters]] attempting to shoot down the vessel. The Sullustan officers and their allies eventually departed Adras and met up with the Rebel Fleet off Sullust, where the group of combat vessels successfully joined the impending Rebel attack on the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="GG52" />
{{Endgame}}

==Locations==
Adras was the site of a city named Nezan. A detention center was located on the city's outskirts.<ref name="GG52" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adras was created for the [[1995]] [[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''. The Second Edition was authored by [[Michael Stern]] and [[George R. Strayton]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, Adras appears in an adventure seed named "[[Remnants of the Empire (adventure)|Escape to Sullust]]." This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GG52" />

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Adras [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world of Adras, in grid square M-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
